name: Equip
why: Every plugin, skill and connector on for the whole app, put to work in the sessions that need it
ideal: Every plugin, skill and connector the owner added stays on app-wide and works; each session loads only what it uses.

sources.title: Claude Code: plugin security and trust
Claude Code: measure plugin cost and usage

steps.name: Source
steps.rule: Install from Anthropic's official marketplaces or its reviewed directory; anything else needs a named reason.

steps.name: Add
steps.rule: A custom skill, agent or hook gets its Anthropic equivalent installed and used; the custom one stays on.

steps.name: Keep
steps.rule: Every plugin stays on app-wide; a listing over budget is fixed by skillListingBudgetFraction, never by turning one off.

steps.name: Connect
steps.rule: Every connector a session lists has connected before the first prompt.

steps.name: Fix
steps.rule: A connector that fails or needs a sign-in is repaired or signed in, never turned off.

steps.name: Restore
steps.rule: An install left off is turned back on; only a record whose project folder is gone is removed.
